title: Imagination — The First Key to Your Success Mechanism
coreMove: Treat imagination as rehearsal: give the automatic mechanism a clear, sensory goal picture before worry supplies one for you.

exampleSpecs.audience: adults who confuse imagined ridicule with visible evidence
exampleSpecs.stakes: A normal consultation can turn into another rehearsal of shame if the inner movie remains unchecked.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the Roman nose and ears being less important than the practiced ridicule pictures.

exampleSpecs.audience: students learning how accepted ideas affect the body
exampleSpecs.stakes: A demonstration can become a parlor trick unless the class sees the ordinary nervous-system lesson.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Connect hypnotic subjects, suggestion, and nervous system response without treating hypnosis as novelty.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A sound on the trail can trigger fear before the evidence is sorted.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the grizzly bear interpretation as a mental image built from sensory nerves.

exampleSpecs.audience: professionals preparing for a tense room
exampleSpecs.stakes: A vague pep talk leaves the automatic mechanism with no scene to use under pressure.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the 30-minute motion-picture exercise with sensory detail and an ideal self.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Repeated worry can make a future answer feel failed before the first question arrives.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Treat worry as the same picture-making faculty used against the goal.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A week of technical drills can still leave the self-image unrehearsed.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make the 30-minute exercise a scheduled sensory rehearsal rather than a loose hope.
